name: account-integration-truth-base
description: A student workflow plugin for assignment intake, truth-base voice rules, APA checking, inbox monitoring, and deadline planning.

defaultPrompt: Review my weekly assignments and build a safe plan.
Check this draft against my rubric and APA 7.
Update my coursework schedule from new messages.
